textual.observation: The speaker presents income amounts, including "$20" for one person, and invites viewers to contact a provided number through a "pure contact link"; the title also promotes "single day income 1800 plus."

evidence.quote: Today with the help of applying she got that 20$ which is around 1800 rupees. So if you want you can also message this number I will give you a pure contact link.

textual.context: Presented in a promotional or testimonial-like manner, but the source records do not establish whether the income claim is verified or whether the speaker is endorsing a specific offer.
textual.potential_relevance: The stated monetary return is linked to applying and to a request that viewers message a number for a contact link, which may require later assessment of the offer, conditions and destination.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the payment source, eligibility conditions, required costs, data requested, transaction outcome, or whether the quoted income is genuine. The phrase "with the help of applying" is ambiguous.

visual.observation: A mobile webpage visibly presents a claimed income of "single day income 1800 INR" and a displayed profit amount of "5 683.5 BUSD," alongside a visible "Sign up" control, a personal referral link, partner/team counts, and an overlaid instruction to message the displayed phone number.
visual.context: Promotional or referral context is unclear from the sampled frames; the page shows a profile-like dashboard with signup and personal-link elements.
visual.potential_relevance: The displayed income/profit claims are visibly connected with signup, a personal referral link, and contacting the displayed number, which is a reward claim linked to requested actions and a referral/team structure.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish whether the figures are genuine, whether anyone completed signup or transferred money, what information or payment would be requested, or whether the displayed page represents the claimed service.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes joining a Forsage-linked system by presenting rapid income claims and directing viewers to contact the promoter for a signup link. It emphasizes team and partner metrics alongside claimed earnings, indicating a recruitment-dependent earning structure rather than an ordinary financial tutorial or neutral report.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promotion connects earnings to a multi-person team structure: the narrated profile claims income, the frames display Partners 36 and Team 549, and the video encourages viewers to contact the promoter and sign up. This is more than a one-level referral because the visible structure includes a large team and program matrix.
